items.title: Norman Brownlee Interview, 1961-05-05
items.q: And after he left me, he went with Jan Garber and he played with him about 11 or 12, maybe 14 years.

ctx.x: But Jan Garber, this friend of mine, Martin, his home originally was Sarasota, Florida. And after he left me, he went with Jan Garber and he played with him about 11 or 12, maybe 14 years. The last I remember that I had seen him. And he was still with Garber. Very fine man.
Let's see, you had a trumpet too on the records.
